knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Model answer from source: Tag the tool out of service and replace it rather than compensating with extra force.
Protection is chosen from the risks identified for the actual task.
Tools are kept in a bag or tray at ground level and not left at height.

practicalCriteria: instructions: Inspect ten sample tools or images and create a defect/rejection register.; evidence required: Demonstrate tool inspection and controlled use under supervision.; supervision: Competent supervisor; no unlicensed regulated work
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 4: Tag and remove any defective tool and record it.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Secure the workpiece and clear the area of trip hazards.
Stop work if procedure step 7 is not done: Store tools safely and do not leave them at height.
